question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
Here the correct answer is Awakened.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the** blank number 2** is **"awakened."**
 
• The sentence suggests that Sam was sleeping and was disturbed by the sound of the thunderstorm.
 
• The word **"awakened"** means **to be roused from sleep or to become aware of something.**
 
• Therefore, it is the most suitable option to fill in the blank.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• I was **awakened **by the sound of the alarm clock.
 
• The loud noise outside **awakened **the baby.
 
 
 
• The other options are not appropriate in the given context.
 
• "**Cracked**" and "**broken**" both refer to something that has been damaged or shattered, and do not make sense in this context.
 
• "**Shakened**" is not a proper English word, and therefore, cannot be used to fill the blank.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *A **(1)** __loud__* *thunderstorm rolled across the Delta before dawn, and Sam was **(2) **__**awakened**__* *by the crack of lightning. He heard raindrops dropping hard against the open windows above the hallway. Then he heard them drip and (3)________ against the wall under the windows not far from his cell. The (4) _______- of his bed was suddenly cool. Maybe today (5) _________ not be so hot.*
